Name: Snowswans Oatchi (Pikmin 4) Dog Replacer
Author: Snowswans
Description:
It's everyone's favorite rescue pup, Oatchi from Pikmin 4! He replaces every dog, so if you have this mod installed, he will be any of them. Make sure to remove any mods that may conflict with this.

Things I should probably do in the future:
[list]
[*]Add more options (Moss, some Pikmin enemy, etc.)
[*]Replace barking with Oatchi sound effects
[*]Make Oatchi's head appear in character creation menu/character profile
[/list]
How to use:
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Download the latest version of Content Patcher
[*]Find the mods folder in the contents of Stardew Valley
[*]Place both this and Content Patcher inside
[*]Play the game with a dog as your pet
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Joswan's Oatchi Dog Replacer
Manifest.Description: Replaces the third dog with everyone's favorite rescue pup, Oatchi!
Manifest.Author: Joswan
